description: Finds published parts of one type by spec. `filters` maps a spec field to a number (equals, or any element of a list), a string (case-insensitive substring) or {min, max} (numeric range). `query` matches brand and model. An unknown field returns the type's field list. Example: type=motor, filters={"stator": "2207", "weight_g": {"max": 33}}.

filters.description: Spec field -> number, list, substring or {min, max}, e.g. {"stator": "2207"}

query.description: Words that must appear in brand + model

name: search_parts
title: Search FPV parts
